opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow members. Postgraduate, Full and Fellow member applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend. Value of the award and frequency of application vary with membership category.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support member engagement at Society meetings and Society-sponsored events. Covers registration for the conference(s) applied for and attendance at the meeting dinner(s), plus a contribution toward advanced standard travel and accommodation on presentation of receipts. Members can apply to attend up to three meetings with one application.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members; the applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award. Funds cannot be used to buy out teaching time, support salary costs, or attend conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education. Funds must be used within 12 months of the grant award date.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members; the applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award. Applications should be physiological in nature. Funding cannot be used to support salary costs or to attend conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Animal costs, experimental consumables and small equipment purchases are permitted. Funds must be used within 12 months of the grant award date.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow. Funding cannot be used to support salary costs, to attend conferences or to fund membership payments. Award is paid to the institution via invoice, not to an individual.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events. The next application round is now open.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who are members. Members will normally only be awarded this funding once during their period of membership.
opportunities.summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential. Funds should be used within 12 months of receipt to support the activity outlined in the application. Funds cannot be used to pay staff salaries but may be used for consumables, registration for Higher Education Academy Fellowship or other justifiable sundries.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full members or Fellows of the Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer. Funding cannot be used to support salary costs or to attend conferences. Award is paid to the institution via invoice.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address equity, diversity and inclusion principles, intended for projects that directly investigate or address inclusion and diversity issues in the physiological sciences in either teaching or research. Funds must be used within 6 months of the award date.
